items.title: CCI relaxes commitment norms, extends filing window to 60 days

The move comes at a time when the regulator is considering two key commitment applications by IndiGo parent InterGlobe Aviation, and Google. The CCI has sought stakeholder comments on these applications but hasn't yet approved any of them.
